book.name: SUMBAOGHA
book.title: Allahri Imap So'oap Sumbaogha Sembe Musari Mome Toro Pibog Yubu

content: Sem Ham Yafetdi nimi mangkahiekne (10:1-32)
Mag nubunge nenekori nimi opsiogpa Nuh elmabo tanekori nimi liksiekne ane.
Yafetdi liksiogne sembe palilamap
Yafetdi liksiognena Gomer, Magog, Madai, Yawan, Tubal, Mesekh apna Tirasap.
Yafet elme me yandonge Gomer. Gomerti liksiogne Askenas, Rifat, apna Togarmaap.
Yafet elme Yawandi liksiogne Elisa, Tarsis apna Kitim nimiap Dodanim nimiap.
Yawandi mangkahiogne likto yabiogne sisa nimi ene mag longorop mag abomag urop nimi tala-tala likto mangaro yabiogti, sindi yubu babe yubu a'ero-aero lerop nimi wamek.
Hamdi liksiogne sembe palilamap
Ham elmabona Kush, Misraim, Put apna Kanaanap.
Hamdi me yandonge Kush. Kush elmabona Seba, Hawila, Sabta, Raema, apna Sabtekhaap. Kush elme Raema. Raema elmabona Syeba apna Dedanap.
Kushti me nen nhon mangaro aogne Nimrod. Nimrod samenag nimi nubunge so'oag wamogne Nimrod wamog.

Allahri Nimrod pone yeplamogpa, Allah whingag mana winang yin sae yonge wamog. Wamogpa nimi etne yin sae yo tanena nimiri, “El yonge Nimrod Allah whingag wamog saog uro wamla,” aropti nimiri si lerop.
Samenag saelbamsiog asna Babel, Erekh, Akad apna mog so'o ni Sinearap.
Nen aneko mog so'o eldi saelbamsinepne nubu nenero Asyur piogti Niniwe apna Rehobot-Ir apna Kalah apna
Resen sobaog. As tompare abene sobaog aghana as nubu sirikne Kalah sobaog.
Hamdi me nabinge Misraim. Misraimdi Ludim nimi mangaro, Anamim nimi mangaro, Lehabim nimi mangaro, Naftuhim nimi mangaro,
Patrusim nimi mangaro, Kaftorim nimi mangaro, Kasluhim nimi mangkahiogne nimi ene sisana Filistin nimi.

Hamdi elme Kanaan. Kanaandi me yandonge mangaro aogne Sidon, nabinge Het, apna Yebusi nimiap, Amori nimiap, Girgasi nimiap, Hewi nimiap, Arki nimiap, Sini nimiap, Arwadi nimiap, Semari nimiap, Hamati nimiap. Kanaandi mangaroba sisa as tala-tala likto piogti
as soro wamekne tane: Sidon, Gerar, Gaza, Sodom, Gomora, Adma, Zeboim apna Lasaap
Anena Hamdi nimi sisa likto piogne sindi as babe mo, yubu babe mo likto piog.
Semdi liksiogne sembe palilamap

Yafet eldo Sem. Sem elmabo mangaro piognena: Elam, Asyur, Arpakhsad, Lud apna Aramap. Aramdi mangkahiognena: Us, Hul, Geter apna Masap. Sem elme elabo me Arpakhsad. Arpakhsadti mangkaognena: Selah, Selahri mangkaognena Eber. Ane sembena Eber nimiri, “Nu Sem ilisang wamap,” senelamek.
Eberti me phende mangkahiognena samenagne Peleg. Nimi si Peleg anena, “Mog so'o tala-tala a'eptaek,” aro. Peleg ilipsaena Yoktam.

Yoktamdi mangkahiognena Almodad, Selef, Hazar-Mawet, Yerah, Hadoram, Uzal, Dikla, Obal, Abimael, Syeba, Ofir, Hawila, apna Yobabap. Sin nimi likna nenena Yoktamdi liksiogne. Sin wamekagna Mesa apna Sefar yim heng walelingkirobag sip.
Sem sisa-ag agha nimi mangaro likto piogne sin yubu babe a'ero, as babe a'ero, sindi mog so'o babe a'ero tangtang piog.
Aghana nimi si wamlange nenena Nuh sisaringe, mag nubunge longol langkalamogdi, opsiogpa, Nuhri me wilindi liksiog aghana sin wilindiri mangkahiekne mog so'o as tala-tala nimi aghabog taog.

footnotes.text: As ni si wamlange samenag Israel so'oag ane wamek. Aghana nimi sekelanan nangdi olamsiekti yag lambahiek. Sekelanan nang ene Israel nimi aro wamek.
